goals.title: Full-system takeover, architecture mapping, and modular refactoring
goals.status: Core refactoring complete; launch contract in progress
goals.evidence: After receiving full production access in March, the team audited the clients, backend, databases, infrastructure, payments, and VPN node path; retired the old ProxyBackend; and reduced the API surface from 207 endpoints to 141. To resolve the coexistence of line v1, line v2, and bootstrap response formats, the standardized client-launch architecture is now locked around a catalogue, entitlement data, and connection credentials, using stable endpoint IDs to reduce duplicated compatibility work and connection differences across seven platforms.
goals.nextAction: Implement the standardized contract, retire the old endpoints, and migrate Android, Windows, and iOS compatibly. Close the work with staging and cross-client connection acceptance; do not describe an agreed standard as a completed deployment.
goals.deadline: Continue through year-end Independent acceptance testing for each module

goals.title: Security, no-logs, and least-privilege governance
goals.status: Core fixes complete; boundaries pending closure
goals.evidence: Following takeover, the team fixed four no-logs policy violations, 13.1 GB of request logs, an Nginx attack entry point, JWT logout behavior, and OTP logic. Source-code access now follows least privilege, and staging credentials have begun moving to Key Vault.
goals.nextAction: Close staging/production network isolation, SSH PEM access, production-secret migration, VPN node system-log retention, and periodic access reviews.
goals.deadline: P0 Closure alongside production resilience

goals.title: CI/CD, automated testing, and end-to-end observability
goals.evidence: Delivery progressed from manual packaging to automatic staging APK generation on commit. Android's four-channel build and upload is fully automated in about 15 minutes 52 seconds, backend pipelines were reduced to 30–50 seconds, and database-migration checks, MR quality gates, Crashlytics, and cross-client request IDs were added.
goals.nextAction: Standardize build provenance, test results, signing, artifacts, deployment, and rollback evidence across Android, Windows, iOS, macOS, and Linux, and close the production-alerting loop.
goals.deadline: Continuous engineering standard Cover all seven platforms independently

goals.title: Production resilience, monitoring, off-site backup, and recovery
goals.evidence: Read-replica use, the VPN node health state machine, and request-level diagnostics are established. On August 12, the application, MySQL, and Redis were consolidated in production. The final database backup is still on the production host, so host-level disaster recovery is not yet proven.
goals.nextAction: Establish an off-site replica, perform an actual recovery drill, complete service and VPN node alerting, and record the RTO, data integrity, and cutback procedure.
goals.deadline: P0

goals.title: Traceable production release and user-availability acceptance testing

blockers.text: 3 Gap in Dedicated Line Renewal Experience for Existing Customers — New Discovery — After existing paid customers' dedicated lines expire, The system does not allow renewal at the same VPN node; a new dedicated line must be purchased instead. Rebuying will reallocate VPN nodes, disrupting customers' original IPs and routing habits, which is a risk point for paid user loss. Team Planning: Introduce 'Automatic Renewal Deduction' — Automatically deduct from balance or bound payment channels before expiration, Maintain original VPN node binding unchanged. (No re-purchase, no VPN node reallocation). The scope for Sprint 3 is locked and included in the Sprint 4 candidates , shared with the VPN node automation roadmap and FFF Universal Payment module to avoid duplicating efforts on two products. Business Value: Dedicated lines are high-ticket items; renewal friction directly impacts LTV; automatic renewals can simultaneously reduce customer service intervention and involuntary churn due to payment failures.
